Author: dexcss
Name: Glamour Sorter
Description: Sorts glamour-able gear from your inventory into the Glamour Dresser and Armoire. Normal sets are stored as outfit glamours; seasonal/Armoire-eligible sets go to the Armoire without using a dresser slot. Completes existing outfit sets instead of creating duplicates, and leaves true duplicates in your bags to sell. Open your Glamour Dresser, run /gsort, review the preview, then store.
Punchline: One-click sort of set pieces into the Glamour Dresser or Armoire, no duplicate slots.
